repos_data.description: P2P Docker registry capable of distributing TBs of data in seconds
MCP server for searching and getting up-to-date information about NPM, Cargo, PyPi, and NuGet packages.

repo_meta_data.description: Self-hosted artifact registry and pull-through cache in one binary. 17 formats: Docker/OCI, Maven, npm, PyPI, Cargo, Go, Raw, RubyGems, Terraform, Ansible Galaxy, NuGet, Pub, Conan, CPAN, RPM, Debian/APT, Hugging Face. No database, about 15 MB RAM idle, supply-chain curation built in.
